description: Medidas de la Radiación Solar en Montevideo is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Intendencia de Montevideo. Medidas de los niveles de radiación solar en la ciudad de Montevideo en diferentes horas de acuerdo al siguiente esquema: - Hasta 5 moderado - 6 a 7 alto - 8 a 10 muy alto - Mas de 11 extremo. Coverage: Intendencia de Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Intendencia de Montevideo. Its tags are Harvest, IOT, MEDIO AMBIENTE, Radiación Solar, UV. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
